subtitle: A clearer view of the air around you.
healthSub: General guidance based on the available model-based air quality estimate.
generalText: Most people can continue normal activities. If you are unusually sensitive, take breaks if you notice symptoms.
sensitiveText: Children, older adults and people with heart or lung conditions should consider reducing prolonged, strenuous outdoor activity.
mapText: See air quality across regions on an interactive map.
compareText: Compare air quality between your favorite cities.
demoNotice: Sample interface · Values are illustrative and are not live measurements.
noData: Air quality data is currently unavailable.
modelDisclaimer: Model-based estimates, not direct measurements from a ground monitoring station.
loadError: Could not load air quality data. Check your connection and try again.

aqiDescriptions.good: Air quality is good. Outdoor activities are generally safe.
aqiDescriptions.moderate: Air quality is acceptable. Unusually sensitive people may experience minor symptoms.
aqiDescriptions.unhealthySensitive: People in sensitive groups may experience health effects. The general public is less likely to be affected.
aqiDescriptions.unhealthy: Everyone may begin to experience health effects. Sensitive groups may experience more serious effects.
aqiDescriptions.veryUnhealthy: Health alert: everyone may experience more serious health effects.
aqiDescriptions.hazardous: Health warning: everyone should avoid outdoor exposure as much as possible.

good.title: Outdoor activity is generally fine
good.text: The current AQI is in the Good range. Most people can enjoy normal outdoor activities.
good.sensitive: No special precautions are usually needed at this level.

moderate.title: Most people can continue usual activities
moderate.text: Air quality is acceptable for most people. Consider reducing prolonged, intense activity if you are unusually sensitive.
moderate.sensitive: People who are unusually sensitive to air pollution should watch for symptoms.

unhealthySensitive.title: Take extra care with outdoor activity
unhealthySensitive.text: The AQI is Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups. Consider reducing prolonged or strenuous outdoor activity.
unhealthySensitive.sensitive: Children, older adults, and people with heart or lung conditions should limit prolonged or strenuous outdoor activity.

unhealthy.title: Reduce prolonged outdoor exertion
unhealthy.text: Air pollution may affect everyone. Reduce prolonged or strenuous outdoor activity and consider moving activities indoors.
unhealthy.sensitive: Sensitive groups should avoid strenuous outdoor activity and follow local health advice.

veryUnhealthy.title: Avoid strenuous outdoor activity
veryUnhealthy.text: Health effects are possible for everyone. Stay indoors when possible and keep outdoor activity short and light.
veryUnhealthy.sensitive: Sensitive groups should avoid outdoor physical activity.

hazardous.title: Avoid outdoor exposure
hazardous.text: The AQI is in the Hazardous range. Remain indoors where possible and follow official local health alerts.
hazardous.sensitive: Sensitive groups should remain indoors and follow public-health instructions.

unavailable.title: Recommendations unavailable
unavailable.text: A current AQI value is not available, so tailored guidance cannot be provided.
unavailable.sensitive: Check again when the latest air-quality data has loaded.
